explanation_result.explanation:
-5.7% day-over-day move (z-score -5.36) on 2025-10-21. Reasons given by 2 reports from that day:
- "Gold Price Today : Spot Gold Slides After Record High ; Futures Volatile as Dollar Firms" (el-balad.com, 2025-10-21). Reported move: down, size not stated. Reason: heavy profit-taking and a firmer U.S. dollar. Quote: "After touching fresh all-time highs in recent sessions, the metal faced heavy profit-taking and a firmer U.S. dollar, prompting the steepest single-day pullback in years." (source: a58eea23098bf8d1)
- "Цена фьючерса на золото ускорила падение до 5 %" (pnp.ru, 2025-10-21). Reported move: down 5.49%. Reason: Падение цен на золото последовало после нескольких недель роста. Quote: "Падение цен на золото последовало после нескольких недель роста." (source: 28405416ab17e39f)
